rules.why: The field is a native <select>: the browser gives it the keyboard, the value and the announcement.
A <label for> names the field; clicking it focuses the field.
With a visible label, aria-label makes what is read differ from what is seen.
A field in error points to its message, and the message has text - the color alone says nothing.
Every id in aria-describedby exists, or the help text is never read.
The chevron is paint; the native select already announces itself.

manual.why: An <option value=""> placeholder is the selected one, never a loose option in the middle.
